extName.description: Extension name shown in the store and toolbar.

extDesc.message: Fetch and view Salesforce record metadata in-page — search every field, inspect values, and open a full All Data view.

popupInactive.message: Open a Salesforce Lightning record page to use MetaForce.

popupHint.message: Click the search icon at the edge of the record page to search fields or open All Data.

apiVersionHint.message: Used for describe, record, and update REST calls (default v67.0).

enableAllDataHint.message: Adds a tab that lists every field of the record with label, API name, type, and value.

enableInlineEditLabel.message: Allow inline editing in All Data

enableInlineEditHint.message: Double-click an updateable field to edit it and save changes back to Salesforce. Use with care — this writes to live records.

allDataCopySoqlTitle.message: Copy a SELECT query for this record

allDataOpenConsoleTitle.message: Copy the SOQL and open the Developer Console

triggerPositionHint.message: Middle-right stays clear of Salesforce's own Help and chat buttons.

shortcutNeedModifier.message: Include Ctrl, Cmd, or Alt. Free combos:

shortcutReserved.message: The browser reserves that combo — it can't be overridden. Free combos:

shortcutDuplicate.message: Already used by another MetaForce shortcut — pick a different combo.

shortcutDiscouraged.message: Set — note this combo shadows a common browser action on Salesforce pages. Click Save to apply.

shortcutSet.message: Shortcut set — click Save to apply.

shortcutHint.message: Click a shortcut, then press the keys you want (include Ctrl, Cmd, or Alt). Shortcuts work while a Salesforce page is focused. Combos the browser reserves — Ctrl/Cmd+T, W, N, Cmd+Q… — can't be overridden, so MetaForce won't let you pick them.

whatsNewToggle.message: opens and closes this panel from the keyboard.

whatsNewTabs.message: switch between the Search and All Data tabs.

whatsNewPosition.message: The MetaForce button now sits at the middle of the right edge, away from Salesforce's own buttons.

whatsNewCustomize.message: Both the shortcuts and the button position are yours to change in Settings.
